originalFailingStep.tcStepDescription: Click the 'Create' button (Create PO) in the application toolbar
originalFailingStep.errorMessage: strict mode violation: getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }) resolved to 2 elements

rootCause.summary: SAP Guided Tour creates ambiguous locator
details: The SAP Guided Tour dialog appears non-deterministically after login (session-based or config-driven)
When the tour appears, it creates a hotspot overlay element: <div role='button' aria-label='Create Purchase Order'>
The script's generic locator getByRole('button', { name: 'Create' }) matches BOTH the actual Create button AND the tour hotspot
During exploration (2026-07-08), the tour did NOT appear, so the locator was unambiguous and passed
During test runner execution (2026-07-20), the tour DID appear, causing the strict mode violation
rootCause.evidenceFromReExecution: Tour dialog appeared at step 2 (PO list page load). After dismissing tour with 'Leave Tour' button, the Create button locator resolved to exactly 1 element and worked correctly.

resolutionSteps.action: Detected Guided Tour dialog on PO list page
resolutionSteps.dialogContent: You can use various filter options to display purchase orders. To create a new purchase order, choose Create in the upper right screen area.

resolutionSteps.action: Clicked 'Leave Tour' button to dismiss tour
Verified Create button locator now unambiguous

resolutionSteps.pageTransition: New Purchase Order creation form opened

failingStepAnalysis.resolutionNote: The original locator IS correct. The issue is that the guided tour must be proactively dismissed after navigating to the app, BEFORE attempting to click the Create button.

sapBehaviorNotes: PO was created successfully. All fields were accepted and auto-populated correctly. PO number generated and displayed in page title and URL. SAP is functioning as expected.

sapFinalState.successIndicator: Page title changed from 'New Purchase Order' to '4500066120 (Standard PO)', URL changed from IsActiveEntity=false to IsActiveEntity=true

patchStrategy.approach: Add proactive guided tour dismissal logic

changes.action: Add guided tour detection and dismissal after app loads
changes.logic: After app tile click, wait for page load, then check for guided tour dialog and click 'Leave Tour' if present

changes.note: The locator is correct. The issue is environmental (guided tour presence), not the locator itself.

secondaryFailure.description: Retry attempt failed during sign-out confirmation
secondaryFailure.rootCause: Same root cause: guided tour overlay blocked pointer events
secondaryFailure.note: After dismissing tour proactively in this re-execution, sign-out worked without issues

explorationComparison.explorationNote: No guided tour popup in this session
explorationComparison.difference: Exploration run did NOT encounter the guided tour, so the Create button locator was unambiguous. Current run DID encounter the tour, confirming the non-deterministic nature of the tour appearance.
explorationComparison.implication: The tour appearance is session-based or configuration-driven. Scripts must handle both cases (tour present / tour absent).

nextStep: Execute /patch-scripts TC-CS-001 to apply the fix
